_about: Named file dialects: how to read a table file. 'csvw' holds W3C CSV on the Web dialect properties (https://www.w3.org/TR/tabular-metadata/#dialect-descriptions). 'columns' is 'header' (the first non-comment row names the columns) or 'field_order' (no header row; columns are the croissant's fields in order). 'rest_column': true means the last column takes all remaining cells of a row as a list (GMT). 'header_in_comments': true means the last comment line before the data names the columns. 'spec' is the format's published definition, when there is one.

csv.description: Comma-separated values with a header row.

tsv.description: Tab-separated values with a header row.

csv-noheader.description: Comma-separated values with no header row: columns are the croissant's fields in order.

tsv-noheader.description: Tab-separated values with no header row (UniProt idmapping files): columns are the croissant's fields in order.

tsv-quoted.description: Tab-separated values with a header row, where fields (and names) may be double-quoted.

tsv-commented.description: Tab-separated values after a '#' comment block (release, date, notes), then an ordinary header row (Alliance downloads).

tsv-comment-header.description: Tab-separated values after a '#' comment block whose last line names the columns ('#ID(s) interactor A	...', Alliance MITAB files).

tsv-commented-noheader.description: Tab-separated values after a '#' comment block, with no header row: columns are the croissant's fields in order (FlyBase files that list their columns only in the comments).

vcf-4.description: Variant Call Format 4.x: '##' meta-information lines, then a '#CHROM POS ID REF ALT QUAL FILTER INFO ...' header row, then tab-separated records.

mitab-2.7.description: PSI-MI TAB 2.7 molecular interactions: a tab-separated header row whose first name starts with '#' ('#ID(s) interactor A'), then records. '-' means no value.

mitab-2.7-comment-header.description: PSI-MI TAB 2.7 after a '#' comment block whose last line names the columns ('#ID(s) interactor A	...', FlyBase and Alliance interaction files). '-' means no value.

gaf-2.2.description: GO Gene Association File 2.2: '!' header lines, no column-name row, 17 tab-separated columns in a fixed order.

gpad-2.0.description: GO Gene Product Association Data 2.0: '!' header lines, no column-name row, 12 tab-separated columns in a fixed order.

gpi-2.0.description: GO Gene Product Information 2.0: '!' header lines, no column-name row, 11 tab-separated columns in a fixed order.

gmt.description: Gene Matrix Transposed (GSEA, MSigDB, Enrichr): one gene set per row, no header row; tab-separated name, description, then any number of genes. The last column takes all remaining cells as a list.

flybase-tsv.description: FlyBase precomputed file: '##' comment lines (title, date, notes), a header row starting with '#', tab-separated records, and a '## Finished' line at the end.

sssom-tsv.description: SSSOM mapping set (TSV): a '#'-prefixed YAML metadata block (curie_map, license, ...), then a header row (subject_id, predicate_id, object_id, mapping_justification, ...).

robot-template-tsv.description: ROBOT template (TSV): a header row, then a template row of ROBOT strings (ID, LABEL, A rdfs:comment, SC %, ...) that says what each column means, then data rows.

robot-template-csv.description: ROBOT template (CSV): a header row, then a template row of ROBOT strings that says what each column means, then data rows.

ctd-csv.description: CTD comma-separated report: a '#' comment block (licence, then '# Fields:' and the column names on a commented line), no column-name row.

ctd-tsv.description: CTD tab-separated report: a '#' comment block (licence, then '# Fields:' and the column names on a commented line), no column-name row.
